name: Metyrapone
aliases: MEO885, mepyrapone, Metirapona, Metopiron, Metopirone®, Metyraponum
summary: Metyrapone, sold under the brand name Metopirone, is a medication which is used in the diagnosis of adrenal insufficiency and occasionally in the treatment of Cushing's syndrome (hypercortisolism). It is part of the steroidogenesis inhibitor class of drugs.

pharmacology.text: Metyrapone blocks cortisol steroidogenesis by acting as a reversible inhibitor of 11β-hydroxylase. This stimulates adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) secretion, which in turn increases plasma 11-deoxycortisol levels.

uses.text: Metyrapone can be used in the diagnosis of adrenal insufficiency.
